spacetime_emergence.spatial_openness: O_spatial=f(Dir,F),基于卦德对应空间属性判定

advanced_detection.mahalanobis: 考虑向量协方差结构的第二层筛网
advanced_detection.isolation_forest: 不依赖距离度量的高维异常检测
advanced_detection.autoencoder_residual: 学习正常样本分布,重构误差大=精微能量结构
